query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS aiPromotionRules (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  ruleType ENUM('margin_based', 'seasonality_based', 'rotation_based', 'hybrid') NOT NULL,
  marginThreshold DECIMAL(5,2),
  seasonalityFactor DECIMAL(5,2),
  rotationThreshold DECIMAL(5,2),
  isActive BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS impactSimulations (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  planogramId INT NOT NULL,
  scenarioName VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  baselineCA DECIMAL(15,2),
  baselineMargin DECIMAL(15,2),
  baselineStockouts INT,
  projectedCA DECIMAL(15,2),
  projectedMargin DECIMAL(15,2),
  projectedStockouts INT,
  caImpactPercent DECIMAL(5,2),
  marginImpactPercent DECIMAL(5,2),
  stockoutReductionPercent DECIMAL(5,2),
  confidenceScore DECIMAL(5,2),
  status ENUM('draft', 'simulated', 'approved', 'applied') DEFAULT 'draft',
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
